== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will attempt to move within melee range of their target in order to use this spell.

== Notes ==
* This spell is an effective knock down even with no points in Air Magic.
* The enemies do not have to be attacking the user to be knocked down.
* This skill combines well with [[Aftershock]].
